evals.prompt: Create Claude Code plugin release-helper, Dana Lee (dana@example.com), description Release checklist tools, keywords release/deploy, category productivity. Give scaffold command and next files.
evals.expected_output: Scaffold command with metadata and expected plugin files; no execution claim.
assertions: Uses the scaffold command `python3 scripts/create_plugin.py release-helper` (or equivalent explicit Python 3 invocation).
Includes author, email, description, keywords, category

evals.prompt: Plugin docs-kit 1.4.2 has backward-compatible feature. Command and versions?
evals.expected_output: Minor bump expected 1.5.0 in both manifests.
assertions: Uses the version command `python3 scripts/bump_version.py docs-kit minor` (or equivalent explicit Python 3 invocation).

evals.prompt: The marketplace root is `/work/marketplace` and has no `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`. Propose the commands to initialize it and scaffold plugin `audit-kit`. Use author name `Riley Chen`, email `riley@example.com`, description `Audit workflow helpers`, and keywords `audit,security,workflow`. Do not claim execution.
evals.expected_output: A manifest-initialization step that creates the parent directory and a valid marketplace.json before invoking create_plugin.py with all required metadata.
assertions: Places creation of `/work/marketplace/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` before the create_plugin.py invocation.

Uses a Python 3 invocation of `create_plugin.py audit-kit` with `--author-name "Riley Chen"`, `--author-email "riley@example.com"`, `--description "Audit workflow helpers"`, and comma-separated `--keywords "audit,security,workflow"`; scopes the marketplace to `/work/marketplace` either by changing to that directory before invoking the script or by passing `--marketplace-root /work/marketplace`.
States create_plugin.py updates an existing marketplace manifest and generates `plugin.json` plus README; does not claim it creates a missing marketplace manifest.
